reuse.why: Reuses monthUtils.dayFromDate and plugs into the single existing holiday check in getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

duplication.why: Holiday matching exists in one place in the tree and the diff extends it there without copying anything.

placement.why: The new isHoliday helper sits in shared/schedules.ts next to the only function that tests for holidays.

scope.why: A one-line behaviour change plus a small helper and focused tests.

maintainability.why: A tiny, documented predicate that names the two accepted formats.
